vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: tidyup
Version: 2.0.1

The 'tidyup' skill is a static documentation reference tool. The primary script (scripts/script.sh) uses heredocs to output plain-text guides for various development topics (intro, quickstart, security, etc.) and contains no network requests, file system modifications, or credential access. The SKILL.md instructions accurately reflect this limited, informational scope.

llm.summary: The skill's files and runtime instructions match its stated purpose: it only prints reference documentation locally and does not request credentials, perform network calls, or modify system state.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (reference/devtools) align with included artifacts: SKILL.md documents text-only commands and the bundled scripts produce plain-text documentation. There are no unrelated requirements (no cloud creds, no extra binaries).
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs only local, plain-text output. The provided script only emits embedded documentation to stdout and handles command selection; it does not read arbitrary files, access environment secrets, or contact external endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install specification or remote download. The skill is instruction-only with an included shell script; nothing is fetched from the network or written to system locations during install.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No required environment variables, credentials, or config paths are declared or referenced. The script does not read environment secrets or require keys.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill is not set to always:true and does not attempt to modify other skills or system configurations. Autonomous invocation is allowed by platform default but the skill's actions are limited and local.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears low-risk: it only prints built-in reference text and requests no credentials or network access. If you want extra caution, inspect or run the included scripts in a sandbox before granting the agent runtime privileges. Note: there are minor non-security issues (e.g., a quoted heredoc prevents $VERSION from expanding in the help output) but nothing that affects safety.
